Game Overview

At its heart, AtomLinker is a match-3 game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of AtomLinker follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is AtomLinker?

AtomLinker is a free match-3 game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is AtomLinker free to play?

Yes, AtomLinker is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
